rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Brings back memories. This is the trading point where we all first met, isn't it?
rows.display_text:
「Brings back memories. This is the
trading point where we all met, isn't it?」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: That's right. We fought all sorts of enemies here, and then Captain Lowen showed up...
rows.display_text:
「Right. We fought all sorts of enemies
here, then Captain Lowen showed up...」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Sure, but if I recall, we didn't want to get dragged into it, so we ran off.
rows.display_text:
「Sure, but we didn't want to get
dragged into it, so we ran off.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: So our battle begins again, here in this land...
rows.display_text:
「So our battle begins again, here in this
land...」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Everyone, $c from North Ameria is here.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, $c from North Ameria is
here.」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: I've confirmed each of $c's ships.
rows.display_text: 「I've confirmed each of $c's ships.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: It's been a while, everyone.
rows.display_text: 「It's been a while, everyone.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: I can't say I'm glad for a reunion under these circumstances, but let's first confirm everyone's safety.
rows.display_text:
「I can't say I'm glad for a reunion like
this, but let's first confirm everyone's
safety.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: I hear Banjo and the others have obtained some promising intelligence. I'd like to move straight into a briefing.
rows.display_text:
「I hear Banjo and the others got some
promising intel. Let's move straight into a
briefing.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: Understood. I'll get the crew assembled.
rows.display_text: 「Understood. I'll get the crew assembled.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: A new enemy of unknown identity... and to face them, comrades gathered together beyond nation and standing...
rows.display_text:
「A new enemy of unknown identity... and
against them, comrades gathered beyond
nation and standing...」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: Now then... how shall we see this fight through...
rows.display_text:
「Now then... how shall we see this fight
through...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Been keeping well, Renton?
rows.display_text: 「Been keeping well, Renton?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: You haven't changed a bit either, Garrod. Glad you're safe.
rows.display_text:
「You haven't changed a bit either,
Garrod. Glad you're safe.」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Hey... what happened to that new look you had before the space-time repair?
rows.display_text:
「Hey... what happened to that new look
you had before the space-time repair?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: That was just for special occasions. Normally I'm sticking with the same old me, not trying to act more grown-up than I am.
rows.display_text:
「Only for special occasions. Normally, I'm
still just me -- no acting grown-up.」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Eureka... you came too.
rows.display_text: 「Eureka... you came too.」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Nirvash went off on its journey together with the Scub Coral, but I thought there might still be something I could do.
rows.display_text:
「Nirvash left with the Scub Coral, but I
thought there might still be something I
could do.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: We're Gekkostate too, after all. Even if we can't fight in an LFO, there's still plenty for us to do.
rows.display_text:
「We're Gekkostate too. Even without an
LFO, there's still plenty for us to do.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Listen to you talk. You forced your way aboard again, same as always.
rows.display_text:
「Listen to you. You forced your way
aboard again, same as always.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: I appreciate your cooperation, Holland. I hear you're the one who gathered up our comrades scattered across the world.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks for your help, Holland. I hear
you gathered our comrades scattered
across the world.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: It's a dangerous world out there -- can't have Talho or the kid in her belly settling down anywhere safe.
rows.display_text:
「It's a dangerous world -- can't have
Talho or the kid in her belly settling
down safe anywhere.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Figured it was about time I tried acting a bit more like a father myself.
rows.display_text:
「Figured it was time I tried acting more
like a father myself.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Heh... becoming a parent really does change a guy, huh.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... becoming a parent really does
change a guy, huh.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Shut it, Jiron. Don't go bringing up the old days.
rows.display_text:
「Shut it, Jiron. Don't go bringing up the
old days.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Now, now, Holland. Let's just let those who don't understand this feeling of fulfillment say whatever they want.
rows.display_text:
「Now, now, Holland. Let those who don't
get this feeling of fulfillment say what
they like.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: Sure, but you're on the same countdown to fatherhood, and you don't look like you've changed one bit.
rows.display_text:
「Sure, but you're on the same countdown
to fatherhood, and you haven't changed
one bit.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: How about Mimsy? Is her belly starting to show by now?
rows.display_text:
「How about Mimsy? Is her belly starting
to show by now?」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Still a ways off, Lieutenant. She's out there today too, cheerfully assisting Shaya.
rows.display_text:
「Still a ways off, Lieutenant. She's
assisting Shaya cheerfully again today.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Anyway, that's why all of us from the Factory are joining up with $c too. Nice to be working with you.
rows.display_text:
「Anyway, that's why we're all from the
Factory joining $c too. Nice working with
you.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Likewise. We're counting on you.
rows.display_text: 「Likewise. We're counting on you.」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: It's not just Gekkostate and the Factory -- us Iron Gear folks are here too, y'know!
rows.display_text:
「It's not just Gekkostate and the
Factory -- us Iron Gear folks are here
too!」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: We're fighting too. Can't get a decent night's sleep with things like that crawling up out of the ground.
rows.display_text:
「We're fighting too. Can't sleep well with
things like that crawling out of the
ground.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Been a while, Shinn. Figured I'd get to see you here too.
rows.display_text:
「Been a while, Shinn. Figured I'd get to
see you here too.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: So the Gran Knights came too.
rows.display_text: 「So the Gran Knights came too.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Of course. Protecting the world from the clutches of evil is our mission.
rows.display_text:
「Of course. Protecting the world from
the clutches of evil is our mission.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: It's not just us, either. Japan's whole army of super robots is joining in.
rows.display_text:
「It's not just us, either. Japan's whole
army of super robots is joining in.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Daisuke and the others, plus Marin and Toshiya, even postponed their departure for space for this.
rows.display_text:
「Daisuke and the others, plus Marin and
Toshiya, even delayed their departure for
space for this.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Earth is my second home. I can't just stand by and watch it get ravaged.
rows.display_text:
「Earth is my second home. I can't just
stand by and watch it get ravaged.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: That's the way of it. We're not setting sail for the sea of stars until we've settled everything here.
rows.display_text:
「That's the way of it. We won't sail for
the sea of stars till everything here's
settled.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: Which is exactly why we have to bring peace back as soon as possible.
rows.display_text:
「Which is exactly why we have to bring
peace back as soon as possible.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: So that's why we went and pulled Beal and Zambot 3 back up out of Suruga Bay.
rows.display_text:
「That's why we pulled Beal and Zambot 3
back up out of Suruga Bay.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: But that swarm of unmanned drones... they're a tougher enemy than we expected.
rows.display_text:
「But that drone swarm's a tougher enemy
than we expected.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: And with their identity and purpose still unknown, there's not much we can do about it...
rows.display_text:
「With their identity and purpose still
unknown, there's not much we can do...」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Nothing to worry about. Seems like Roger and Banjo have been working together with old man Fudo on this.
rows.display_text:
「Nothing to worry about. Roger and Banjo
seem to have worked with old man Fudo on
this.」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: From what they've learned, this is apparently the rendezvous point they settled on for all of us.
rows.display_text:
「From what they've learned, this is
apparently the rendezvous point they
picked for all of us.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: The mystery enemy's stronghold being in Japan, of all places... I was floored when I heard that.
rows.display_text:
「The mystery enemy's stronghold being in
Japan, of all places... I was stunned to
hear that.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: So that's why Japan hasn't been attacked by the drones...
rows.display_text:
「So that's why Japan hasn't been
attacked by the drones...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: You're...
rows.display_text: 「You're...」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Yo... $n. Good work on that whole space-time repair thing.
rows.display_text:
「Yo... $n. Good work on that whole
space-time repair thing.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Mr. Rand... so you're joining $c too.
rows.display_text: 「Mr. Rand... so you're joining $c too.」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Eh... it just kinda happened. Figured I'd go along with that big-forehead general's recruiting drive.
rows.display_text:
「Eh... it just happened. Figured I'd go
along with that big-forehead general's
recruiting drive.」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: I'd crossed paths with Jiron and the Black Southern Cross before too. Figured this counts as part of the repairman trade.
rows.display_text:
「I've met Jiron and the Black Southern
Cross before, too -- part of the repair
trade.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: This wild-looking guy a friend of yours?
rows.display_text:
「This wild-looking guy a friend of
yours?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes... he's someone who looked after me.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... he's someone who looked after
me.」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Rand Travis. Nice to meet you.
rows.display_text: 「Rand Travis. Nice to meet you.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: I hear you looked out for one of my people. Much appreciated -- likewise, nice to meet you.
rows.display_text:
「I hear you looked out for one of my
people. Appreciate it -- likewise, nice to
meet you.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Asakim's gone now... Mr. Rand's able to smile again, isn't he.
rows.display_text:
（Asakim's gone now... Mr. Rand's able to
smile again, isn't he.）

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Though he's a little... no, actually pretty overbearing about it...
rows.display_text:
（Though he's a little... no, actually
pretty overbearing about it...）

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Nice to meet you, $n. My darling's been in your debt.
rows.display_text:
「Nice to meet you, $n. My darling's
been in your debt.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Darling...!?
rows.display_text: 「Darling...!?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: I'm Mel Beater. Acting president of the wandering repair outfit, Beater Service...
rows.display_text:
「I'm Mel Beater, acting president of
wandering repair outfit Beater Service...」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: ...and also my darling's fiancee.
rows.display_text: 「...and also my darling's fiancee.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Nice going, mister... You just shot straight to the top of my list of guys I respect.
rows.display_text:
「Nice going, mister... You just shot to
the top of my list of guys I respect.」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: What kind of criteria is that, exactly...!?
rows.display_text:
「What kind of criteria is that,
exactly...!?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: So, this fiancee thing...
rows.display_text: 「So, this fiancee thing...」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Eh... explaining it's too much trouble. Let's just leave it at that until this whole mess is sorted out.
rows.display_text:
「Eh... explaining is too much trouble.
Let's leave it at that till this mess is
sorted out.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: So she was the person you were looking for, Mr. Rand.
rows.display_text:
「So she was the person you were looking
for, Mr. Rand.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: I'm really glad you found the person you love. You two make a great match.
rows.display_text:
「I'm really glad you found the person
you love. You two make a great match.」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Hold on a second! On second thought, I'm going to explain this properly!
rows.display_text:
「Hold on a second! On second thought,
I'm going to explain this properly!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Oh, come on, it's fine. Let's just say I've got him reserved.
rows.display_text:
「Oh, come on, it's fine. Let's just say
I've got him reserved.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Yes. Please let me offer my congratulations too.
rows.display_text:
「Yes. Please let me offer my
congratulations too.」

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Ah, well... good enough. I got to see a good smile out of them, at least.
rows.display_text:
（Ah, well... good enough. I got to see a
good smile out of them, at least.）

rows.speaker: Rand
rows.en: Sounds like a lot's happened, but it seems $n's found something, in $n's own way.
rows.display_text:
（Sounds like a lot's happened, but $n's
found something, in $n's own way.）

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Then, over on your end too...?
rows.display_text: 「Then, over on your end too...?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Yeah... around the time the drones woke up all over the world, King Gainer started up on its own too.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah... around when the drones woke up
worldwide, King Gainer started up on its
own too.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Then maybe it's not just the Turn A -- King Gainer might have it too...
rows.display_text:
「Then maybe it's not just the Turn A
-- King Gainer might have it too...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: ...that system they call the Executor built into it, I mean.
rows.display_text:
「...that system they call the Executor
built into it, I mean.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Gentlemen, assemble in the briefing room. It's time you all learned about the enemy we're up against.
rows.display_text:
「Gentlemen, assemble in the briefing
room. Time you learned about the enemy
we're up against.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Just what I wanted to hear. Whatever they turn out to be, I won't forgive anyone who tramples on peace and happiness.
rows.display_text:
「Just what I wanted. Whatever they are,
I won't forgive anyone trampling peace
and happiness.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Whoever it was that awakened the Black History's legacy... do we know their identity?
rows.display_text:
「Whoever awakened the Black History's
legacy... do we know who it was?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: And how exactly do the Turn A and King Gainer factor into this...?
rows.display_text:
（And how exactly do the Turn A and
King Gainer factor into this...?）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: What is this uneasy feeling...? Is King Gainer trying to tell me something...?
rows.display_text:
（What is this uneasy feeling...? Is King
Gainer trying to tell me something?）
